responsibility: Defines the generic vector-lowering pass that expands GIMPLE vector operations into target-supported operations or scalar/piecewise code when direct vector support is unavailable. It contains helpers for extracting and constructing vector elements, selecting compute types and optabs, rewriting vector expressions with bit-twiddling fallbacks, cleaning up EH/CFG issues introduced by expansion, and registers the veclower/veclower2 passes that run after vectorization or other vector-producing optimizations.
